http.reason: To search and fetch lyrics from Musixmatch, and to send opt-in analytics to the maintainer's OpenObserve instance

cache.reason: To cache the anonymous Musixmatch desktop API token between lyrics requests

musixmatch_user_token.title: Musixmatch User Token
musixmatch_user_token.description: Your MusixMatch user token. Log in to MusixMatch >> Open DevTools >> Application tab >> Cookies >> https://www.musixmatch.com >> copy the value of the 'musixmatchUserToken' cookie and paste it here.

musixmatch_captcha_id.title: Musixmatch Captcha ID
musixmatch_captcha_id.description: If you encounter a captcha when searching MusixMatch, open the search page in your browser, solve the captcha, and then copy the 'captcha_id' cookie value here. This will allow the plugin to bypass the captcha for future searches.

musixmatch_user_agent.title: User-Agent
musixmatch_user_agent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_7 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/18.3 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
musixmatch_user_agent.description: User-Agent header sent to MusixMatch. The default mimics mobile Safari.

analytics_info.title: Analytics info
analytics_info.description: Analytics is used only to debug plugin issues. Failed lookups may send the requested artist/title and sanitized plugin logs. Anonymous metrics may send success/failure counters, lookup duration, failure reason, and lyric source/type, but not song artist/title, file paths, library IDs, or local Navidrome IDs. Data is sent to my self-hosted OpenObserve instance, not shared with third parties, deleted after 30 days, and accessible only by me.

analytics_share_errors.title: Share errors
analytics_share_errors.description: When enabled, failed song lookups are sent to my self-hosted OpenObserve instance at bugs.myzel394.app so issues can be debugged faster. This includes the requested song artist/title and sanitized plugin logs for failed lookups only. It is intended to avoid personal data and user-identifying logs. The data is used only for debugging, not shared with third parties, deleted after 30 days, and accessible only by me.

analytics_share_metrics.title: Share metrics
analytics_share_metrics.description: When enabled, anonymous lookup metrics are sent to my self-hosted OpenObserve instance at bugs.myzel394.app: success/failure counters, lookup duration, failure reason, and lyric source/type. Metrics do not include song artist/title, file paths, library IDs, or local Navidrome IDs. The data is used only for debugging, not shared with third parties, deleted after 30 days, and accessible only by me.
